m: अभि-√ बाध् -बाधते, to check, stop, RV. viii, 5, 34; to attack (in battle), MBh. xii, 3731; to cause pain, afflict, R.
अभि-बल n. (in dramatic language) overreaching or deceiving anybody by disguise, Sāh.
a: अभिबलं — A technical term in Rhetoric; अभिबलमभिसंधिश्छलेन यः S. D. 375 ‘an inquiry or examination by an artifice’. See Ratn. 3.

m: अभि-बुद्धि f. (in Sāṅkhya phil.) N. of a function of the intellect (comprising अध्यवसाय, अभिमान, इच्छा, कर्तव्यता, and क्रिया).
a: अभिबुद्धिः — f. An organ of apprehension, a बुद्धींद्रिय or ज्ञानेंद्रिय (opp. कर्मेद्रिय); these are the eye, tongue, ear, nose and skin.
